"""Inspect and retain actual full-size paired training inputs before model use."""

import collections
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import yaml
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
from paired_response_data import source_batch
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar
from demosaic.data import CleanDataset
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/paired-response-data-inspection-v1'
external=Path('/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/paired-response-data-inspection-v1')
assert not root.exists() and not external.exists()
assert shutil.disk_usage(repo).free>60.5*2**30 and shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>156.5*2**30
root.mkdir(parents=True);external.mkdir(parents=True)
config=read(repo/'configs/quality-v143-paired-response-v160.yaml') if False else yaml.safe_load((repo/'configs/quality-v143-paired-response-v160.yaml').read_text())
cases=read(Path(config['previous_trial'])/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
heldout={c.get('source_id') or c['source'].get('sha1') for c in cases if c['kind']=='photo'}
assert len(heldout)==18 and None not in heldout
trainrows={};paths=set();counts={};licenses=collections.Counter()
for key in ['manifest','photo_sampling_reference_manifest']:
    manifest=Path(config[key]);rows=[json.loads(s) for s in manifest.read_text().splitlines()]
    counts[key]={'all_rows':len(rows),'train_rows':sum(r['split']=='train' for r in rows)}
    for row in rows:
        p=(manifest.parent/row['cache']).absolute()
        assert p.is_relative_to(repo) or p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external')
        assert p.suffix=='.npy' and p.is_file(),p
        paths.add(str(p))
        if row['split']=='train':
            assert row['id'] not in heldout
            if key=='manifest':
                assert min(row['shape'][:2])>=512 and row['bin_factor']==4
                trainrows[row['id']]=row;licenses[row.get('license','recorded-by-source-manifest')]+=1
assert len(trainrows)==90782
source_paths=[repo/p for p in ['scripts/paired_response_data.py','scripts/paired_response_objective.py',
    'scripts/coupled_sensor_noise.py','tests/test_paired_response_data.py','tests/test_paired_response_objective.py',
    'tests/test_coupled_sensor_noise.py','configs/quality-v143-paired-response-v160.yaml']]
source_paths+=list((repo/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'))
source_hashes={str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in source_paths}
dest=root/'sources';dest.mkdir()
source_copies=[]
for p in source_paths:
    q=dest/p.relative_to(repo);q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(p,q)
    assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes()
    source_copies.append({'original':ref(p),'frozen':ref(q)})
torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
dataset=CleanDataset(config['manifest'],patch_size=256,seed=config['seed'],synthetic_fraction=0.,flat_fraction=0.,
    augmentation_downsample=2,optical_blur_probability=0.,photographic_low_contrast_fraction=0.,
    reviewed_roi_catalogue=config['reviewed_roi_catalogue'],reviewed_roi_fraction=config['reviewed_roi_fraction'],
    photo_sampling_reference_manifest=config['photo_sampling_reference_manifest'],
    photo_sampling_reference_sha256=config['photo_sampling_reference_sha256'],trace_sources=True)
assert len(dataset)==90782
font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',10)
images=[];batches=[];channel_checks=0
for step in [1,2,5,6,7,10]:
    torch_before=torch.get_rng_state().clone()
    arrays,metadata=source_batch(config,dataset,step)
    assert torch.equal(torch_before,torch.get_rng_state()) and metadata['coupled_pairs']==2
    for c in metadata['cases']:
        if c['source']['kind']=='photo':
            source=c['source']['source'];assert source['source_id'] in trainrows and source['source_id'] not in heldout
            assert Path(source['cache']).is_file() and ref(source['cache'])['sha256']==source['cache_sha256']
    out=external/f'step-{step:04d}-inputs.npz';assert not out.exists()
    np.savez(out,**arrays)
    batches.append({'step':step,'arrays':ref(out),'metadata':metadata,
        'inputs':{k:fingerprint(v) for k,v in arrays.items()},'parent_forwards':0,'adoptable_prefix_inputs':True})
    noisy=noisy_malvar(arrays);target=arrays['target'];size=metadata['native_size']
    xy=(size-160)//2;roi=[xy,xy,160,160]
    wb,matrix=arrays['wb'][0:1],arrays['matrix'][0:1]
    rendered=np.einsum('bij,bjhw->bihw',matrix.astype(np.float64),target[0:1].astype(np.float64)*wb[:,:,None,None])
    exposure=float(.18/max(float(rendered.mean()),1e-8))
    # Fixed first pair of each declared batch;no performance/visibility selection.
    values=[target[1:2],target[0:1],target[1:2]+20*(target[0:1]-target[1:2]),noisy[1:2],noisy[0:1]]
    names=['Constructed background','Constructed present','True delta x20','Noisy background','Noisy present']
    a={'wb':wb,'matrix':matrix};cells=[]
    for value in values:
        cell=pixels(value,a,roi,exposure)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(cell,independent_display(value,a,roi,exposure));cells.append(cell)
    board=Image.new('RGB',(848,212),'#eeeeee');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    draw.text((8,4),f'V160 training data step{step} {metadata["domain"]}; ROI{roi}; RAW exposure{exposure:g}; no model',font=font,fill='black')
    panels=[]
    for j,(name,cell) in enumerate(zip(names,cells,strict=True)):
        box=[8+168*j,44,160,160];board.paste(Image.fromarray(cell),box[:2]);draw.text((box[0],24),name,font=font,fill='black')
        panels.append({'label':name,'xywh':box});channel_checks+=cell.size
    path=root/f'training-step-{step:04d}-pair0.png';board.save(path)
    reread=np.asarray(Image.open(path))
    for panel,cell in zip(panels,cells,strict=True):
        x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y:y+h,x:x+w],cell)
    photo=metadata['cases'][0]['source']
    credit=trainrows[photo['source']['source_id']] if photo['kind']=='photo' else {'kind':'authored procedural source'}
    images.append({'image':ref(path),'batch':ref(out),'metadata':metadata,'pair_indices':[0,1],
        'ROI_xywh':roi,'exposure':exposure,'panels':panels,'no_resize':True,'photographic_attribution':credit,
        'scope':'Training-target/noisy-input inspection,not restoration performance. Delta20 panel is display-only;other4 cells share exposure and no contrast change. Constructed background is not an independent real capture.'})
sheets=[]
for start in [0,3]:
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(848,636),'white')
    for j,item in enumerate(images[start:start+3]):sheet.paste(Image.open(item['image']['path']),(0,j*212))
    path=root/f'sheet-{start//3:02d}.png';sheet.save(path)
    actual=np.asarray(Image.open(path))
    for j,item in enumerate(images[start:start+3]):np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[j*212:(j+1)*212],np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path'])))
    sheets.append({'image':ref(path),'indices':list(range(start,start+3)),'no_resize':True})
assert channel_checks==2304000 and all(ref(p)['sha256']==h for p,h in source_hashes.items())
save(root/'inspection-v1.json',{'status':'constructed-native-paired-training-input-inspection-awaiting-actual-viewing',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'config':ref(repo/'configs/quality-v143-paired-response-v160.yaml'),
    'batches':batches,'images':images,'sheets':sheets,'source_copies':source_copies,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'source_preflight':{'counts':counts,'train_rows':90782,'heldout_photo_ids':sorted(heldout),
        'cached_paths_checked':len(paths),'license_counts':dict(licenses),
        'manifests':{k:ref(config[k]) for k in ['manifest','photo_sampling_reference_manifest','reviewed_roi_catalogue']}},
    'RGB_channels_checked':channel_checks,'constructed_batches':6,'constructed_observations':24,
    'Poisson_sampler_calls':18,'Gaussian_sampler_calls':6,'global_Torch_RNG_unchanged':True,
    'new_parent_DINO_forwards':0,'new_head_forwards':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'dataz_accesses':0,
    'scope':'Six fixed paired batches/24 actual observations retained before model use. Steps1,2,5,6,7,10;first pair displayed without selection. Native160 pixels/no resize;data/target/noise inspection,not model quality. All18 heldout photo IDs excluded from both training manifests;actual photo cache hashes checked. These six exact arrays can be adopted by the future cache-prefix stage without new noise/source construction.'})
print('Constructed6 retained paired input batches;2304000 native RGB channels independently checked;awaiting actual viewing')

These six exact arrays can be adopted by the future cache-prefix stage without new noise/source construction.
